The first release of Lowspeak.

- **Hold fn, speak, release:** your words are typed wherever the cursor is. Press fn twice, or Shift+fn, to dictate hands-free.
- **Online or on your Mac:** OpenAI (GPT Transcribe, Whisper) or Groq (Whisper Large V3 and Turbo), or Whisper and NVIDIA Parakeet locally. When the online service fails, an installed local model takes over.
- **Vocabulary** for names and technical terms, and optional **post-processing** that removes filler words or formats for the app you dictate into.
- **35 languages** for the menu, dialogs and notifications.
- **Help › Quick Reference** lists the gestures; **Help › Report Problem…** opens a form with the version filled in.
- **Apple Silicon and Intel:** one app for both. Local models are built for Apple Silicon; on Intel Macs, online transcription is the better choice.

Something wrong or missing? [Report it on GitHub](https://github.com/sventmueller/lowspeak/issues/new/choose).
